items.a: Online stores, landing pages, and redesigns of existing sites. Each one is built to make it easy for customers to buy, book, or contact you.
Small businesses, creators, and brands worldwide. If you sell something or need people to get in touch, I can help.
Send me a DM on TikTok (@henryknowsweb) or an email with what you sell, who your customers are, and what isn’t working on your current site. I’ll reply with questions and next steps.
Every project is quoted as a fixed price after we talk through your brief, and before any work starts. No surprise costs.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: It depends on the pages, features, and content. Starting prices: a landing page from $350 (one page, up to 6 sections, mobile layout, 2 revision rounds, basic SEO setup); an online store from $1,000 (up to 30 products, checkout and payments set up, up to 5 pages, 2 revision rounds); a redesign from $700 (up to 5 pages, new design, mobile layout, 2 revision rounds). After the brief I’ll send a fixed quote before any work starts.

A landing page usually takes 5–7 days, a store 3–5 weeks, and a redesign 2–4 weeks, counted from the day I receive your text, photos, and content. The timeline mostly depends on how quickly I get your content and feedback.
Yes — 30% upfront, and the rest before the final files are handed over and the site launches. I’ll put it in writing before starting.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Payoneer, bank transfer, or crypto. All quotes are in USD.
Brief, Design, Build, Launch. You tell me what you need, you see a first version, I build the full site, and we go live together.

items.q: Can you build an online store?
items.a: Yes. I build stores on Shopify and WooCommerce, and on Hostinger, with checkout and payments set up so you can start taking orders.

items.q: Do you handle domain and hosting?
items.a: Either way works: I can set it up for you, or guide you through it. The domain and hosting accounts stay in your name, so you always own them.

items.q: Do I need to provide the text and images?
items.a: It helps if you do. If you don’t have them, tell me what you can share and we’ll work out the gaps.

items.q: Will my site work on phones?
items.a: Yes. Every site is designed for phone, tablet, and desktop.

items.q: Will people be able to find my site on Google?
items.a: I set up the basics: page titles, descriptions, headings, fast loading, and a sitemap. Ranking takes time and depends on competition and your content, and I can’t promise a position.
You do. Once the final payment is made, the site and its files are yours.

items.q: What if I need changes after launch?
items.a: Two rounds of revisions are included while we build. After launch, small fixes are free for 30 days. Bigger changes are quoted separately.
Not as a monthly plan right now. After the 30-day fix window, I quote changes as you need them — just DM or email me.
My own showcase builds are being added now, and I only show work I made. I’d rather wait than show someone else’s work as mine. Feel free to DM me for a sample or a call.

items.q: Do you offer a free mockup or consultation?
items.a: A free 15-minute consultation, yes — DM me and we’ll talk through your project. A free mockup, no.

Before you pay a deposit, we agree on the brief, price, and deliverables in writing. You get two rounds of revisions, and if the first design isn’t right, I’ll rework it. If you cancel before I start, you get your deposit back. Once I’ve started, the deposit covers the work done so far. If I can’t deliver what we agreed after your revisions, I’ll refund the unused part of what you’ve paid. After launch, I fix any bugs I caused for 30 days.
